title: Facebook Registration Assistant Update v1.0.10
description:
• 👤 Strict Gender Matching: Fixed exact regex option selector so 'Male' never matches 'Female'.
• 🔄 2-Stage SMS Resend Flow: Automatically clicks 'I didn't get the code', detects the options popup modal, and triggers 'Resend confirmation code' before retrieving OTP.
• ⚡ Fast 1.0s OTP Polling & Apify Verification.
